title: Youth Skills & Employability
summary: HSE / health-and-safety training, vocational skills, CV clinics, interview prep and links to career opportunities.
details: Capacity-building bootcamps, safety certification support, digital literacy and workplace readiness for young people and graduates.

title: Education & Opportunity
summary: Training, mentorship and learning support for students and recent graduates.
details: Scholarships guidance, mentorship circles, study support and graduate transition programmes.

title: Community Support / Food Bank
summary: Food distribution, support for vulnerable families and rapid community outreach.
details: Monthly food packs, emergency relief, school-term support and referrals for vulnerable households.

title: Partnership & Community Development
summary: Collaborations with organisations, community projects and social-impact initiatives.
details: Joint projects with companies, faith groups, schools and other NGOs — from clean-ups to community halls.
